build.scope: PR14 candidate, including startup logging; before the subsequent direct-upstream feature.

authorization.account: Temporary local standard account enrolled by the real installer; fresh CreateProcessWithLogonW token on the existing desktop.
authorization.management: Off, no active journal or recovery block
authorization.credentials: Password generated in memory, not serialized by the harness.

method.cpu: Cumulative Windows job kernel/user time, including exited desktop descendants, plus simultaneous LocalSystem service counters; normalized to one logical CPU.
method.working_set: Sum of process working sets, counting shared resident pages in every mapping.
method.bootstrap: A temporary PowerShell bootstrap starts the standard-user UI inside the job and exits before settling; its earlier CPU is excluded by the measurement baseline.
method.foreground: Native foreground PID sampled with counters; every sample must match the desktop. No claim about unsampled transitions.
method.observation: CDP listener only during counter intervals; client disconnected. No axe, screen reader, verbose browser trace, compilation, or browser regression suite during measured intervals.
method.power: Three-minute display-off timeout observed read-only. An external, bounded SetThreadExecutionState display/system request was used for retries after the first gated interval; it does not change policy or force focus.
method.sampler_local_changes: Scoped display/system lease and its report field added for future foreground retries; CPU and working-set accounting unchanged. Completed intervals predate that sampler lease.
method.privacy: Raw DNS snapshots, paths, account/SIDs, profiles, process IDs and recovery records are excluded from this record.

window_attempts.method: Fresh secondary-logon account/profile, without a benchmark power request.
New secondary-logon account/profile; held open while local checks finished, then user foreground confirmation.

startup_logging.scope: Fresh physical LocalSystem startup recorded fixed events. Failure/retention scenarios remain separately covered by unit and disposable-VM tests.

scope: Both applications were measured simultaneously; separately measured numbers were not added.
All completed window attempts are retained, including intervals that lost foreground.
Profiles and foreground conditions differ; these are not a controlled optimization comparison.
This larger development host does not qualify the specification reference machine or the full Windows 11 compatibility matrix.
Startup, signing, manual assistive technology, native tray-menu and remaining network/installer acceptance work are separate.
result: Simultaneous tray budgets passed; a full foreground interval remains unqualified.
